installs: The repository's own Claude Code marketplace manifest at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, declaring the marketplace schema and its owner, registered with /plugin marketplace add davepoon/buildwithclaude and then installed entry by entry with /plugin install <name>@buildwithclaude; each entry resolves to a directory under plugins/, and the README also documents copying agent and command Markdown files into ~/.claude/agents/ and ~/.claude/commands/ after a clone. This record pins the manifest and does not list, count, or review its entries.
distribution_machinery: scripts/ holds Node tooling for the repository's own files: validate-all.js and the four per-type validators validate-subagents.js, validate-commands.js, validate-hooks.js, and validate-skills.js against four JSON schemas, generate-registry.js builds the site registry, and fetch-plugins.js with github-search-pagination.js collects external listings. web-ui/ is the project's own website. None of it is installed into a host.
not_a_system: A marketplace manifest that lists other packs for installation; it is an install source, not a system, and this record never lists, counts, or reviews its entries.
